what: The Work grid cells are pushed up or down by an amount set per column and flow tied to scroll (scrub 1). Four columns use −250·200·−150·130px, three columns use −200·250·−150px (based on a 1512px screen, proportional to screen width). Columns drift out of step with each other, and each cell fades in early (.3) as it crosses the screen and fades out over .45 starting at .75

options.drift4: Per-column push when four are open (px, comma-separated), default -250,200,-150,130
options.base: Screen width where the push px was measured, default 1512
options.fade: If off, only the push without on/off
options.fadeAt: Where it starts to fade out, default .75 (the on and off shares are lengths on a single timeline chaining .3 + .75 + .45)

from.where: index.html work grid (original projectGrid parallax drifts4·drifts3, scrub 1, fade in .3 · out .45 at .75)
